# Maa Ambey Jewellers

> Handcrafted custom gold & silver jewellery from Liluah, Howrah, West Bengal, India.

## About

Maa Ambey Jewellers is a jewellery shop in Liluah, Howrah specialising in custom-made gold (22K) and silver (925 sterling) pieces. We take your design idea, sketch, or reference photo and handcraft it into finished jewellery. All gold jewellery is BIS hallmarked.

## What We Do

- Custom gold and silver jewellery crafting
- 12 categories: Rings, Necklaces, Earrings, Bangles, Chains, Pendants, Kadas, Maang Tikka, Nose Pins, Anklets, Mangalsutras, Bridal Sets
- AI-powered design generation — choose metal, stones, style and get a photorealistic preview
- WhatsApp-based ordering — send your design directly to our craftsmen

## How to Order

1. Choose a jewellery category on our website
2. Fill in details: metal type, stones, finish, style, occasion
3. Click "Generate Design" to get an AI preview
4. Share the design on WhatsApp for a price estimate
5. Confirm and our craftsmen handcraft your piece

Liluah, Howrah, West Bengal, India. Near Howrah railway station.

## Price Range

Custom jewellery starting from Rs. 5,000. Final price depends on metal weight, stones, and design complexity.
